title: Passkey registration response
description: What the registration page outputs, as the text basalt-passkey.1.<base64url(this JSON)>. Byte fields are base64url without padding. basalt init verifies it and stores the public key. See CONTRACT.md, Approvals.

authenticatorData.description: From getAuthenticatorData(); carries the attested credential id.

publicKeyAlgorithm.description: COSE ES256, the only algorithm accepted.
